skalarkiSettings.heading: Skalarki panels

link.title: Profiler link
link.hint: The SkalarkiIO Profiler runs on the PC the boards are plugged into and offers an SDK server. This app only listens to it; it never changes the Profiler's own ProSim profile.

enabled.label: Watch the Skalarki panels
enabled.hint: Connect to the SkalarkiIO Profiler's SDK server and show the PANELS diagnostics page. Off means no page, no caution, nothing logged.

sdkPath.label: Skalarki SDK folder
sdkPath.hint: The folder with SkalarkiIO.SDK.dll and its support files. The Profiler's Tools folder has all of them. The SDK is yours and is never copied by the app.

skalarkiSettings.sdkMissing: SkalarkiIO.SDK.dll is not in this folder

host.label: Profiler PC
host.hint: The PC the Skalarki boards are plugged into and that runs the Profiler. It can be another PC on the network.

port.label: Profiler SDK port
port.hint: The Profiler's SDK server port. The Profiler's own default is 53000.

catalogue.label: Cockpit catalogue
catalogue.hint: Which family of Skalarki boards to listen to. A32X for the Airbus narrow-body cockpit.

test.title: Connect once to the Profiler, list the boards it reports and read the licence, then disconnect
test.timeout: The Profiler did not answer in time.

boards.title: Boards
boards.hint: Which boards the PANELS page shows and the hardware check walks through. With nothing ticked every board the Profiler reports as connected is watched.
boards.none: The Profiler has not reported any board yet. Save with the link on, or tick boards by name.
boards.autoMode: Nothing ticked: every connected board is watched.
boards.listMode: {0} boards ticked: only those are watched.
boards.labelTitle: The name shown on the PANELS page for this board
boards.json: Power users can also edit the list in settings.json under

actions.title: Lamp test and reconnect
actions.hint: LAMP TEST on the PANELS page lights every output of the chosen boards for this long. HW RESET always asks first.

lampTestMs.label: Lamp test duration
lampTestMs.hint: How long LAMP TEST on the PANELS page lights every output of the chosen boards.

reconnectBackoffMs.label: Reconnect pause
reconnectBackoffMs.hint: How long to wait before trying the Profiler again after a failed connection. Doubles on each failure, up to one minute.
